CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  August 12, 2025

The audio recording of the meeting is available here: DRB Meeting – August 12, 2025 (Audio)

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Nora Hernandez, Chairman; Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman; Michael
  Daninger; Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Stanley Tsai

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – July 22, 2025
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the July 22, 2025, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the July 22, 2025, Regular Meeting of the
  Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Vice Chairman
  Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

  AGENDA

ITEM 5:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-010
  • 3001 West Mission Road
  • Applicant: Rose Bacinski, Shab Vakili, & Bryan Miranda
  • Request: This is an application for the new construction of a 146,352

AGENDA
ITEM 6:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-081
  • 1628 South Primrose Avenue
  • Applicant: Bing Bu
  • Request: This is an application for exterior remodel and new
  swinging vehicular gate on an existing 1-story single-family
  residence. This project was previously approved with conditions at
  the DRB Meeting on July 22, 2025. The applicant is choosing to
  resubmit a revised set of plans for the Design Review Board to review
  which provide changes to certain building elements and features, and
  provides further information and details that describes the applicant’s
  proposed Contemporary Mediterranean style.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS - The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  3
  08/12/2025
   1) Recess and/or provide a stucco trim to the south front facing
  window, which creates a reinterpretation of a classic thick adobe
  wall typically seen in Mediterranean architecture.
  2) Emphasize the mass of the roofing system that presents a heavy
  appearance to the overall roof structure, which is a common
  architectural feature of Mediterranean homes.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Provide a recess with stucco trim to the south front facing window,
  which creates a reinterpretation of a classic thick adobe wall
  typically seen in Mediterranean architecture. The applicant should
  adjust the trim as needed to accommodate decorative gable vent
  features.
  2) Provide a decorative feature to the south front facing gable similar
  to the north gable notch detail.
  3) Emphasize the mass of the roofing system that presents a heavy
  appearance to the overall roof structure, which is a common
  architectural feature of Mediterranean homes by emphasizing the
  eaves and fascia with the option of thickening the metal roof
  system.

  •  Moved by Vice Chairman Udani, Seconded by Board Member
  Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-1-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger
  Noes:  Ng
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai
